name: @uuidna/qpu
description: An exact quantum processing unit served over MCP at https://qpu.uuidna.com: Lean-checked theorems, formula families as hex-program UUIDs, live public data checks and quantum receipts. Reads need no auth; storage writes need a Bearer token.

scripts.build: node scripts/version-lock.mjs && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter=./dist/quantum/processing/unit/receipt.js --test-reporter-destination=stdout dist/quantum/processing/unit/*.test.js dist/families/*/test.js
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:scripts && npm run readme
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run version:lock && npm run build
scripts.ship: npm run build && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.lean: lake build && node scripts/lean-bundle.mjs --check && lean src/quantum/processing/unit/index.lean
scripts.version: npm run version:lock && npm run lean:embed && git add src/quantum/processing/unit/version.ts
scripts.version:auto: npm run build && node -e "import('./dist/mcp/version.js').then(m => m.autoVersion()).then(r => console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)))"
